name: Pedro Sánchez
quote: This was an attack and a violation of Spain's territorial integrity. [Defending the regularisation programme against EU criticism:] Solidarity and empathy are optional. Respect for European treaties and the facts is not. Spain has received 234,000 migrants since 2021 — Italy has received 478,000.

name: Juan Jesús Vivas
quote: It is impossible for 60,000 people to enter without Moroccan approval. We have been mistreated and held in contempt. [Jul 30, on the unaccompanied-minors facility:] It is operating at 2,400% of ordinary capacity. [Aug 21, after hundreds returned to the El Trampolín beach camp hours after eviction:] Moving them from Trampolín to other places in Ceuta does not show a willingness to solve the problem.

name: Fernando Grande-Marlaska
quote: It was a necessary meeting to align current and future approaches. The outcome was satisfactory and served to recognise Spain's efforts. [after the Aug 4 EU interior ministers videoconference] Italy's checks are completely pointless and disproportionate. [Aug 7, after Rome refused Madrid's request to withdraw the Schengen suspension] There is no risk of a terrorist threat. [Aug 13, addressing parliament's Schengen committee on the July arrivals]

name: José Manuel Albares
quote: The Italian government's remarks were inappropriate. [after Madrid summoned Italy's ambassador over Meloni and Salvini's Schengen-suspension comments]

name: Giorgia Meloni
quote: This is an extraordinary measure intended to safeguard national security and prevent possible repercussions for our nation. [announcing Italy's suspension of Schengen free movement with Spain, effective Aug 1]

name: Matteo Salvini
role: Deputy PM & Infrastructure Minister of Italy
quote: Joined Meloni in announcing the Schengen suspension against Spain and in publicly backing calls for Spain's suspension from the Schengen area over its handling of the Ceuta crossing.

name: Matteo Piantedosi
quote: Checks will remain in place until security risks to Italy are completely ruled out. [Aug 13, addressing parliament's Schengen committee, declining to set a new review date after the mid-August checkpoint passed without change]

name: Antonio Tajani
role: Deputy PM & Foreign Minister of Italy
quote: Italy's own July 15 daily arrivals were 15,323 — down 54% from 2025 and 50% from 2024. [rejecting Spanish criticism of Italy's border stance by pointing to Italy's declining migration numbers]

name: Ursula von der Leyen
quote: The images from Ceuta are unacceptable. [expressing support for Spain and offering operational and financial assistance following the crossing]

name: Magnus Brunner
quote: This is a test of our European resilience. [offering Frontex support for surveillance, registration and returns at the Aug 4 emergency videoconference]

name: Mette Frederiksen
quote: Uncontrolled immigration poses a threat. [co-leading, with Italy, the 22-country letter to von der Leyen and backing Schengen-suspension measures against Spain]

name: Christian Stocker
quote: Austria could temporarily close its own borders if the situation in Spain is not brought under control. [warning issued alongside Family Minister Claudia Bauer's accusation that Spain was 'effectively handing out entry tickets']

name: Mari Rantanen
quote: Spain has completely failed to protect the external border. On that basis they cannot be members of Schengen. [Aug 1, announcing Finland was preparing its own border controls against Spain]

name: Government of Morocco
role: Moroccan Ministry of Interior / Embassy statements
quote: Morocco expresses regret over the loss of life and supports legal and orderly migration. [denying deliberate facilitation of the crossing and attributing it to smuggling networks and false rumours spread on social media]

name: Sidi Mohamed Omar
quote: Morocco has long weaponised migrant influx for political blackmailing and regional destabilisation. [describing Morocco as an autocratic government that uses its own citizens as 'cannon fodder']

name: Elma Saiz
role: Spanish Minister of Inclusion, Social Security and Migration
quote: [Aug 21, on plans to expand Ceuta's reception capacity to roughly 4,000 places via four additional sites — Loma Colmenar, La Hípica, the old Cavalry barracks football pitch and the Guano site:] Humanitarian care is organised case by case, with specific criteria based on vulnerability.

name: Miguel Ángel Pérez Triano
quote: [Aug 24, rejecting opposition calls for his resignation over the handling of the crisis:] An absolute act of irresponsibility and cowardice.

name: Borja Sémper
quote: [Aug 24, demanding a faster government response:] All the immigration units that are needed should work three shifts daily to process returns.

name: Josep Borrell
role: Former EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs
quote: [Aug 24, on the wider European reaction to the crisis:] Hysterical, disproportionate and absurd. Most EU countries, except France, Portugal, Luxembourg and Ireland, failed to show solidarity.

name: Mónica García
quote: [Aug 22, dismissing disease-outbreak claims tied to the crisis as] xenophobic, while confirming the deployment of roughly 25,000 vaccine doses (chickenpox, diphtheria, polio, tetanus) as a standard precaution.

name: UNICEF
role: UN Children's agency — child protection response
quote: Called for separate, dedicated housing for unaccompanied migrant minors and urgent protection from trafficking risk, after 862 minors were left in Ceuta with only 29 child-specific accommodation places available as of Aug 3.

name: Ángel Víctor Torres
role: Spanish Minister of Territorial Policy — Ceuta 'single command' coordinator
quote: The priority is [voluntary] return, but I cannot deceive [citizens] — it will be a long process.

name: Kissy Chandiramani
quote: The tension in the city of Ceuta is very high — there has been no response from the government.
